items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I think his name was Talley(?) -- I had formerly known him as Barrymore. He was a trumpet player who had played with Dizzy for a while. And he had married Dakota Staton...

ctx.x:
1960...
We left there and went to Atlantic City, and we played the Atlantic City Jazz Festival, which was quite an experience. I got to hang out with Oscar Peterson and the trio, and a lot of other people. We worked Atlantic City, and leaving there... I think we did a club there after the Festival. Our next engagement was in Chicago at the Show Lounge out there on the... Oh, I can't remember the name off it. [PROBABLY THE ROBERTS SHOW LOUNGE ON 63rd STREET] It was a big club. We did two weeks there, I believe.

Anyway, I was very unhappy with the job, because it seemed to be the kind of a job that you could never get settled on. Dakota seemed to be the kind of a person who would pay a lot of compliments about the way you were playing one night, and the next night there would be something wrong with everything. And I think it was out of some frustration that she had with her husband, who I think his name was Talley(?) -- I had formerly known him as Barrymore. He was a trumpet player who had played with Dizzy for a while.…
